regions.merged_text: Ernest Hyland - 42 - stomach cancer - (of Windsor) formerly an orangeman - 7yrs. past teaching Catechism to his children; ex- pecting operation, wife gently reminds him to prepare for what might be. He invites her to his First Communion ... received on First Friday - was baptized last Wednesday ..... had prepared the happy surprise for his wife and mother-in-law, latter had been bed-ridden for four years. could not be moved without bones be- ing broken. When she heard of the conversion of son-in-law, she sighed aloud "now my work is finished". She also received Com- munion last Friday and died next day - ( last Sat. ) Mr. Hyland's little daughter aged 8, died peacefully after fearful suffering. She assured her father that she was offering all for his conver- sion. . Operation undertaken, had to be abandoned. Find- ing two big cancers in stomach, Dr. orders "sew him up" ... March 12 improving. . March 18 fever up to 106 - still conscious.
